title: The Replacements
tagline: Pros on strike. Everyday guys get to play.
about: When the pros go on strike, a washed-up college quarterback and a team of scabs get four games to save the Washington Sentinels' season.
cue: Serve the sundae when Falco hits Murphy for the winning touchdown.
faces: HAWKERS IN EVERY AISLE. CATCH IT IF YOU CAN.
Falco says his fear is quicksand. Molten chile con queso and salted corn chips.
Nigel kicks a 65-yard field goal. Cheddar and mustard rarebit on thick toast.
Sold in the stands all four quarters.
Franklin fears going back to the mini-mart.
McGinty finds Falco on his houseboat.
Murphy catches the winner as time expires. Fudge brownie with vanilla ice cream and hot fudge.
The scabs brawl with Martel at the bar. Cold lager with a bourbon back.
Ice-cold cola in a stadium cup
"Pain heals, chicks dig scars, glory lasts forever."
On the big screen tonight: Lost the Sugar Bowl by 45. Dancing in the cell after the bar fight.
Prices subject to change. The Replacements, 2000. Images: TMDB.

Molten chile con queso and salted corn chips.How to make it250g tasty cheese, grated125g Monterey Jack or mozzarella, grated1 tbsp cornflour250ml evaporated milk1 small brown onion, finely diced2 jalapenos, finely chopped1 tomato, diced1 tsp ground cumin1 tbsp butter300g salted corn chipsToss the cheeses with the cornflour.Soften the onion and jalapenos in the butter with the cumin.Add the evaporated milk and bring to a simmer, then stir in the cheese a handful at a time until smooth.Stir in the tomato and serve hot with the corn chips.Nigel Gruff's 65-yard Welsh rarebitNigel kicks a 65-yard field goal. Cheddar and mustard rarebit on thick toast.How to make it250g vintage cheddar, grated30g butter1 tbsp plain flour100ml milk2 tsp English mustard1 egg yolk4 thick slices of sourdough1 tsp smoked paprikaMelt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the milk until thick.Take off the heat and beat in the cheddar, mustard and egg yolk.Toast the bread, spread thickly with the cheese and grill until bubbling and spotted brown.Dust with paprika and cut into fingers.Hot pretzels with mustardSold in the stands all four quarters.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.GrillMini-mart chilli dogsFranklin fears going back to the mini-mart. Beef franks under chilli with cheese and onion.How to make it8 beef frankfurts8 split-top bread rolls300g beef mince1 brown onion, finely diced, plus 1 for topping2 tsp chilli powder1 tsp ground cumin200g tomato passata100g tasty cheese, grated4 tbsp yellow mustardBrown the mince with the diced onion, add the spices and passata and simmer until thick.Grill the franks, turning, until blistered.Toast the rolls, add a frank and smother with chilli.Top with cheese, raw onion and mustard.Houseboat grilled swordfish rollsMcGinty finds Falco on his houseboat. Grilled swordfish with lemon mayo in a soft roll.How to make it600g swordfish steaks2 tbsp olive oil1 tsp Old Bay seasoning4 long soft rolls5 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise1 lemon, zested and juiced1 tbsp capers, chopped2 cups shredded cos lettuce2 tomatoes, slicedMix the mayo with the lemon zest, a squeeze of juice and the capers.Rub the swordfish with oil and Old Bay and grill on a very hot pan 2 to 3 minutes a side.Toast the rolls and spread with the lemon mayo.Fill with lettuce, tomato and thick slices of swordfish.SweetsGlory lasts forever brownie sundaeMurphy catches the winner as time expires. Fudge brownie with vanilla ice cream and hot fudge.How to make it200g dark chocolate, chopped150g butter200g brown sugar3 eggs80g plain flour30g cocoa powder500ml vanilla ice cream125ml thickened cream100g milk chocolate50g roasted peanuts, choppedMelt the dark chocolate and butter, then beat in the sugar and eggs and fold in the flour and cocoa.Bake in a lined 20cm tin at 170°C until just set with a fudgy middle.Heat the cream and pour over the milk chocolate, stirring until smooth.Serve warm brownie squares with ice cream, hot fudge and peanuts.DrinksBar brawl boilermakerThe scabs brawl with Martel at the bar.
